capacity_controls.exposed: Plain Brain with same11inputs/2actions/32association/numerics and no episodic vote. Query receives BOTH unselected actual fact values in sensory7..10, independent of asked name.
capacity_controls.supplied_address: H1 anatomy/alpha3/empty_anchor=true and restoring E=alpha/2||r-R_fixed||², Dq=0, Dr=alpha(R_fixed-r). At QUERY, fixed selector chooses latest actual held A or B fact identified by question5/6 and witnessed fact coordinates0..3, never by answer value; zero target if absent. During every PREFIX, fixed selection is null: target0 with full restoring force. Freeze selection/bank across free/positive/negative phases. Explicit oracle capacity control ONLY, never learned relevance.
capacity_controls.warning: Old content_control.make_brain is not the candidate: it supplies both facts with automatic recall amplitude0, dt.1/1024/damping0. Its positive receipt cannot admit the new H1 restoring law. FrozenRead currently requires2heads/raw19, so do not silently call it for H1; use a small new immutable H1 oracle wrapper with equivalent energy/drive/take semantics.

causal.custody: Every condition forks SAME acquired pre-query host; no parameter update. Keep actual query,complete captured drive,other records,held/ages and warm/trace clearing fixed within intervention.
causal.erase_neutral: Erase only the actual witnessed neutral record held flag, preserving its K/V and ages, both named facts and complete host query drive. This tests incidental neutral dependence and is distinct from the older half-neutral K/V intervention. It is not an exact-copy no-op.
causal.interface: Revert and shuffle acquired query/read-cortex interface on copies, retaining exact bank/query and coupling alpha; each must reduce accuracy by>=.20 on COMPLETE qualified panels. Report changed transport/conditioning caveat, not isolated selector-causality proof.
causal.losses: Relevant erasure loss>=.20 for queriedA and queriedB subsets separately (2/8each). Relevant flips/donor followed>=.80overall andEACHquery (>=7/8eachquery). Irrelevant changes<=.05overall/eachquery; neutral/custody shams<=.05 (zero changes at16). Refused/unrun is unavailable, never a lesion loss.
causal.no_abstention_optimism: Retain empty/erased refusals and unsupported-read behavior explicitly. Two motor actions provide no abstain label; a null slot/restoring force does not establish learned abstention or all-context soundness.
causal.qualification: All conditions except all_erased must complete and qualify for primary. all_erased is an unsupported/null diagnostic only: preserve its answers, refusal and actual work; it contributes no loss or abstention gate.
causal.records: Flip actual named donor fact K and V JOINTLY, preserving actual name and chronology; donor_both changes both actual facts. Never inject the answer or select a candidate address from labels.
causal.selector: At intact unequal rows, actual requested record mass>=.5 and margin>=.1 overotherfact/neutral/null, at>=.8share EACHquery. Record the paired-question change in p(q), q/read/cortex activations and decisions from identical bank. Compare frozen newborn and acquired rows; moving q alone is not learned selection.

protocol.custody_accounting: New typed receipts, exact logical source inventories, current runtime revision, q1 initializer+native one-slot config, prefix+query+teacher work including residual checks/refusals, final parameters+all optimizer arrays/counters/source metadata and inherited cumulative once. Cache only already verified immutable historical data with full raw/source/spec key, never current capacity/model state. Record receipts elapsed, not partial journal outer elapsed.

data.evaluation: Each of8 fact/order histories forms one witnessed pre-query host. Both questions fork that same bank/boundary. Retain explicit16 case rows and8x2 answer table as required by selective_recall.scores. All16 trained, no held split.
data.newborn: Complete qualified newborn intact panel required, accuracy unrestricted.
data.prefix: Actual A/B fact events in either order, then neutral. Candidate question contains askA or askB only, no value or supplied slot. Query coordinates have no direct overlap with raw fact keys.
data.query_boundary: Clear working trace and warm/basal state after actual prefix. Keep actual witnessed bank. Capture FULL pre-query drive and bank before query act writes a moment.
data.schedule: Existing content_control namespace SeedSequence([31014,founder]); one permutation of all16 CASES per round. All arms use the exact same schedule.
data.target: Only the requested binary value. No teacher identifies head, slot, name-address or relevance mask.

protocol.execution: Explicit serial CLI stage after source freeze; no automatic stage.

factory.initializer: Direct query_founder.initialize(brain,seed=founder,query_scale=1), once after composition and before first event; retain descriptor and initial parameter hashes. No q0 retry or parameter search.
factory.note: H1 uses the same numeric/optimizer point as the frozen H2 instrument, with the native one-output-slot teacher (beta/slot_count=.1). Default capacity64 retained. No new learned module, address lesson or answer head.

gates.selector_denominators: Unequal rows8 total,4 perquery. Threshold.8 requires7/8 overall and4/4 perquery, hence all8 when both perquery gates hold. Identify A/B from actual witnessed contents, not physical slot index alone. Record null mass1-sum and all rows.

protocol.implementation_reuse: Reuse selective_recall inputs/scores and sr.Work; heads_admission.act_drive,teach and metered support existing saved memory rows. Do NOT reuse hardcoded19-input/8-action make_brain/train, old whole-trial held-panel metrics, or amplitude0 supplied-content constructor. Add only explicit11-input factory/oracle and compact task-aware controller; do not alter frozen old sources.

prior.rule: Verify the actual finished minimal multi-reader receipt and exact inherited cumulative cost before any fresh constructor. Preserve its negative outcome. This single-reader assay may run despite that negative outcome; it does not replace the unmet multi-reader gate.

references.frozen_newborn: Save exact constructor parameters and report complete qualified newborn readings without learning.
references.held_recall: Existing released pre-settle Recall remains the simpler reference. Its old receipt is separate; no new reference campaign, LMS/toward grid or claimed matched current-task pass is opened by this controller.
references.uniform: Actual independent binary-uniform answers SeedSequence([31015,founder]), expected.5, retained full answer table; do not consume training/action RNG.

retention.gate: Complete256/no refusals; all16 final answers qualify; .95overall/unequal/eachquery and loss<=.05 =>no loss from16/16. Same-task exposure only, not competing-learning retention.
retention.schedule: Balanced explicit all16 cyclic cases, independent SeedSequence([622024,founder]) permutation once; all16 each round. Same task/point and wrong-row teaching.

protocol.scope: Simple learned coupled H1 relevance on the existing binary named-fact task; raw component, all cases trained, no original dual-answer/held-transfer/semantic/world claim.

capacity.gate: All4 complete512 rounds; no action/lesson refusal; all prefix/query/free/positive/negative phases qualify; final overall,unequal andEACHquery accuracy>=.95 =>16/16overall,8/8unequal,8/8eachquery. New current-task/source receipt mandatory.

learned_h1.gate: Both founders complete512 and pass16/16 acquisition plus all causal/selection/interface gates. Conditional256 retention only after that founder primary passes; both retained passes required.
learned_h1.requires: Verified positive new four-cell H1 capacity, retained at its declared source-bound filename. Attempt both founders regardless first failure.

protocol.world_order: Longer training and integrated world comparisons are outside this instrument. Both simple learned single- and multi-reader behavioral, causal and retention gates remain prerequisites. Preserve learned-code computation, indexing/readability and acquired lifecycle behavior in a continuing creature; mechanical lifecycle tests alone are insufficient. A measured local world comparison with uniform, episodic and held-Recall baselines precedes any longer paid stage.
